definitions.explanation: The dorsal side of the hand, opposite to the palm.

examples.japanese: {手|て}の{甲|こう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧。
examples.english: The back of my hand is red.

examples.japanese: {手|て}の{甲|こう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please show me the back of your hand.

examples.japanese: {手|て}の{甲|こう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I thoroughly applied sunscreen on the back of my hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{手|て}の{甲|こう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦ひび{割|わ}れ→ひび割れ：29752_hibiware⟧⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧⟦やすく→〜やすい：18367_yasui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In winter, the back of my hands gets dry and tends to crack.

examples.japanese: {手|て}の{甲|こう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦やすい→〜やすい：18367_yasui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦とき→時：03094_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The back of the hand is easily affected by UV rays, so it's better to apply sunscreen when going out.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (possessive) + {甲|こう} (shell, carapace, back). The character {甲|こう} refers to the hard outer surface, as in a turtle's shell.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手|て}の{甲|こう}: back of the hand (dorsal side)
- ⟦{手|て}の{平|ひら}→手のひら：05294_tenohira⟧/⟦{掌|てのひら}→手のひら：05294_tenohira⟧: palm (palmar side)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手|て}の{甲|こう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧ (to wipe with the back of the hand)
- {手|て}の{甲|こう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦キス→キス：09763_kisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to kiss the back of the hand)
- {手|て}の{甲|こう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シミ→染み：05426_shimi⟧ (age spots on the back of the hand)
- {手|て}の{甲|こう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ (to apply to the back of the hand)

USAGE NOTE: {手|て}の{甲|こう} is commonly mentioned in contexts of:
- Skincare and sun protection
- Gestures and body language
- Medical examinations (checking veins, IV placement)

RELATED BODY PARTS:

- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甲|こう} (top of the foot)
- ⟦{二|に}の{腕|うで}→二の腕：06437_ninoude⟧ (upper arm)
- ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧ (finger)
